context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 89 verified all Autorizacoes-Financeiro integration features. GET /api/admin/financeiro/resumo returns distribuicao_gateway with 'manual' key containing count. transacoes_recentes includes is_manual, origem, admin_nome fields. Export endpoints /api/admin/financeiro/exportar/{formato} work for 'pdf' and 'excel' formats, returning 400 for invalid formats. Frontend DashboardFinanceiro shows 'Exportar Dados' button with PDF/Excel dropdown, 'Manual' badge (yellow) for manual authorizations, 'Pago?' status (yellow with ?) for manual transactions, and 'Manual/Cortesia' in the distribution chart.
